# oneuptime_incident_postmortem_template_data (Data Source)

Incident postmortem template data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_incident_postmortem_template_data" "example" {
  name = "example-incident_postmortem_template_data"
}
```

- `id` (String) Identifier to filter by. Optional.
- `name` (String) Name to filter by. Optional.
- `created_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
